honor-realism.png:
Photoreal cinematic advertising keyframe, landscape 16:9, polished campaign art direction. Night city street scene with plausible real people as soft background silhouettes walking past wet asphalt reflecting neon, shallow depth of field. Center hero: a large featureless dark rectangular front-facing compositing proxy — unbranded phone-shaped silhouette with completely blank matte-black screen face, no camera lenses, no notch, no buttons, no logo, no brand marks, no UI, no glass reflections of logos. This is explicitly a generic product insertion stand-in, not a real phone model.

Standout visual narrative: rain and streetlights freeze into suspended ribbons of colored light (cyan, magenta, soft gold) that spiral and hang in mid-air around the proxy, as if the city’s neon has been gently pulled into orbit around the product space. Light ribbons dominate the wow effect; the proxy stays large and centered for later compositing (occupying roughly one-third of frame height). No camera/spec claims, no AI motifs, no battery icons, no waterproof droplets implying product function, no leadership/partnership imagery. No readable text, numbers, logos, or watermarks anywhere. Fictional city, not a recognizable landmark. Live-action photography look only — not CGI sculpture, not illustration.
honor-3d.png:
Premium 3D CGI advertising keyframe, landscape 16:9, sculptural luxury product visualization. Pure computer-graphics look: studio void with soft gradient backdrop in deep charcoal and champagne-gold accents. Center hero: a large featureless dark rectangular front-facing compositing proxy — unbranded phone-shaped silhouette, blank matte face, no cameras, no notch, no buttons, no logo, no UI — clearly a generic product insertion volume, not a real device.

Standout visual narrative: elegant flowing ribbons of liquid metal, brushed gold, frosted glass, and soft pearl materials assemble mid-air into a sculptural stage around the hero — sweeping helical forms, thin orbital rings, and petal-like panels that converge toward the proxy without covering its face. Mechanism is physical material flow and assembly, not vague cosmic wallpaper. Dramatic rim lighting, crisp specular highlights, ray-traced reflections. Product space dominates (large centered silhouette). No photoreal city people. No drawn ink look. No text, logos, numbers, watermarks. No camera arrays, no product function claims, no brand typography.
honor-drawn.png:
True 2D hand-drawn ink and paint illustration advertising keyframe, landscape 16:9 — unmistakably flat illustration, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D CGI render. Visible ink linework, watercolor or gouache washes, paper texture, expressive brush strokes. Elegant campaign palette: deep indigo paper, coral and gold accents, soft teal washes.

Center hero: a large featureless dark rectangular front-facing compositing proxy shown as a simple flat silhouette with blank face — unbranded phone-shape outline only, no cameras, no notch, no buttons, no logo, no UI — reserved product insertion area for later compositing.

Standout visual narrative: a single continuous bold ink stroke begins at the lower left, coils around the silhouette, then blooms outward into a vibrant illustrated miniature world — rooftops, birds, lanterns, trees, and abstract floral forms unfurling from the same unbroken line like a living sketch coming alive. Mechanism is the continuous stroke transforming into world detail. Product silhouette stays large and clear. No photoreal people, no CG materials, no text, logos, numbers, or watermarks. Conceptual advertising sketch only.
